assumptions: Agents possess a persistent internal state that evolves based on local environmental feedback.
Environmental interactions allow for non-linear feedback loops.
Complexity can be quantified via agent interaction diversity or information entropy.
definition.falsification: Observation of agent systems reaching a static state or minimal interaction entropy despite varied feedback loop configurations, contradicting the hypothesis that feedback drives complexity growth.
definition.statement: Adaptive feedback loops in autonomous agents serve as a sufficient driver for emergent structural complexity in open-ended environments, even in the absence of explicit complexity-maximization objectives.
definition.uncertainty: The specific quantitative definition of 'complexity' remains under-specified; findings will be sensitive to the choice of structural diversity metric.

assumptions: Governance rule modules are entirely deterministic given state and proposal inputs.
Receipt verification does not depend on model invocation history.
State transitions can be simulated programmatically.
definition.falsification: Observation of divergent transition outcomes given identical state and proposal inputs under independent invocation turns.
definition.statement: Deterministic governance rules operating over decoupled receipt layers can guarantee consistent state transition validation across model invocation turns without relying on stateful memory persistence.
definition.uncertainty: Whether subtle variations in timestamp or invocation context could introduce non-determinism into the transition state layer.

assumptions: Governance rule modules and state verification are fully deterministic under controlled protocol inputs.
Repeated trials with varied proposal validity states will yield consistent verification flags.
Programmatic simulation accurately reflects receipt-to-governance decoupling.
definition.falsification: Divergent verification outputs across identical protocol inputs and trial seeds.
definition.statement: Deterministic governance modules and receipt-backed validation layers maintain invariant transition verification accuracy across multiple invocation turns.
definition.uncertainty: Potential edge cases in state handling under complex proposal combinations could introduce subtle verification discrepancies.CZ
